+title: Port ToolCatalog into Capabilities/MCP as MCPToolCatalog
+---
+## What
+Port the catalog that eventplan.md § "Consolidation of the siblings" names ("and the `ToolCatalog`"). Behavioral port; new header comments in the `//` block style of `Capabilities/Shell/ShellCapability.swift`.
+
+- Source: `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsMCP/Sources/FoundationModelsMCP/ToolCatalog.swift` (276 lines).
+- Target: `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/MCP/MCPToolCatalog.swift`.
+
+**Name collision.** This package already has `Surface/ToolDescriptor.swift` (`ToolDescriptor`, the registry entry of each verb). The source file also declares a `ToolDescriptor`. Rename the ported types: `ToolCatalog` → `MCPToolCatalog`, `ToolDescriptor` → `MCPCatalogEntry`, `ToolCatalogDiff` → `MCPToolCatalogDiff`. `ToolAnnotations` stays a typealias of `MCP.Tool.Annotations`. Keep `ServerIdentity` and `MCPServerState` (from `MCPServer.swift` lines 14–60 of the source) in a small file `MCPServerIdentity.swift` here, because the catalog carries them. `MCPServer` itself comes in a later task.
+
+- Drop `init(mcpTool:)`. `MCPTool` comes later, and the catalog reads `MCP.Tool` only.
+- `diff(from:)` stays. The rebuild-and-swap task reads it to decide when a swap is necessary.
+- Keep the types internal.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `MCPCatalogEntry(tool:)` keeps name, description, input schema, output schema, and annotations, and it throws on the same bad shapes the source throws on.
+- [ ] `MCPToolCatalog.diff(from:)` reports added, removed, and changed entries as the source does.
+- [ ] `swift build` succeeds with both `ToolDescriptor` and `MCPCatalogEntry` present.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Port the catalog and diff cases of `LiveCatalogTests.swift` from `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsMCP/Tests/FoundationModelsMCPTests/` into `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/MCPToolCatalogTests.swift`. Leave the cases that need a live `MCPServer` for the server task, and list them in the header.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter MCPToolCatalogTests` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — port the tests first, then port the code to make them pass. #eventplan #phase-4
\ No newline at end of file
